306	function computeDepartmentLayout(
307	  allNodes: OrgChartNode[],
308	  departmentList: OrgChartData['departments'] = [],
309	): {
310	  rfNodes: Node[]
311	  rfEdges: Edge[]
312	} {
313	  // ── Layout shape ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
314	  // Row 0 (y=0):                                  [ Yash (LEADERSHIP) ]
315	  // Row 1 (y=LEADER_HEIGHT + DEPT_HEAD_ROW_GAP):  [ Arya ] [ Nova ] [ Quill ] ...
316	  // Row 2 (y=above + LEADER_HEIGHT + LEADER_DEPT_GAP):  Engineering | Research | ...
317	  //                                                     ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐
318	  //                                                     │ Koda     │ │ Scout    │
319	  //                                                     │ Dato     │ │ ...      │
320	  //                                                     │  └ pod-b-db (indent)  │
321	  //                                                     └──────────┘ └──────────┘
322	  //
323	  // Strict leader rule: ONLY agents with `tier === 'leadership' && !reportsTo`
324	  // sit at Row 0. Everyone else lands in a department column or "Unassigned".
325	
326	  // Index nodes by id and by manager (reportsTo) — used for tree traversal.
327	  const byId = new Map<string, OrgChartNode>()
328	  const byManager = new Map<string | null, OrgChartNode[]>()
329	  for (const n of allNodes) {
330	    byId.set(n.id, n)
331	    const key = n.reportsTo || null
332	    if (!byManager.has(key)) byManager.set(key, [])
333	    byManager.get(key)!.push(n)
334	  }
335	
336	  // Top leader detection — resilient to data drift. Tries 4 strategies in order,
337	  // so a stale tier/status field in the DB doesn't strand the chart with no
338	  // Row-0 leader (which would then route every edge to "no manager" and dump
339	  // the CEO into the Unassigned column).
340	  //   1. Strict: leadership tier + no manager (canonical)
341	  //   2. Department-driven: head of any "executive"/"leadership"/"lead" dept
342	  //   3. Any agent with no reportsTo (single root in the reports-to forest)
343	  //   4. Highest-level agent (level desc) — last resort, never null
344	  const yash: OrgChartNode | null = (() => {
345	    const strict = allNodes.find(n => n.tier === 'leadership' && !n.reportsTo)
346	    if (strict) return strict
347	    const execDept = departmentList.find(d => LEADERSHIP_DEPT_IDS.has(d.id))
348	    if (execDept?.head) {
349	      const head = byId.get(execDept.head)
350	      if (head) return head
351	    }
352	    const orphans = allNodes.filter(n => !n.reportsTo)
353	    if (orphans.length === 1) return orphans[0]
354	    if (orphans.length > 1) {
355	      // Prefer the one with highest level/seniority signal
356	      return [...orphans].sort((a, b) => (b.level || 0) - (a.level || 0))[0]
357	    }
358	    return null
359	  })()
360	
361	  // Departments to render — server-ordered. Department head is rendered as a
362	  // Row 1 leader card and EXCLUDED from the column member list.
363	  const sortMembers = (a: OrgChartNode, b: OrgChartNode) => {
364	    if (a.tier === 'leadership' && b.tier !== 'leadership') return -1
365	    if (b.tier === 'leadership' && a.tier !== 'leadership') return 1
366	    if ((b.level || 0) !== (a.level || 0)) return (b.level || 0) - (a.level || 0)
367	    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
368	  }
369	
370	  // Build an ordered, indented member list for one department column. Walks
371	  // the reportsTo tree so sub-managers (e.g. dato) precede their reports
372	  // (pod-b-db indented one level under dato).
373	  const buildColumnMembers = (deptId: string, headId: string | null): MemberInfo[] => {
374	    const out: MemberInfo[] = []
375	    const seen = new Set<string>()
376	
377	    const sameDept = (n: OrgChartNode) => (n.department || UNASSIGNED_DEPT_ID) === deptId
378	
379	    // Direct reports of the dept head (or top-of-column if no head).
380	    const roots = (byManager.get(headId) || [])
381	      .filter(sameDept)
382	      .filter(n => n.id !== headId)
383	      .slice()
384	      .sort(sortMembers)
385	
386	    const visit = (node: OrgChartNode, depth: number) => {
387	      if (seen.has(node.id)) return
388	      seen.add(node.id)
389	      out.push(toMemberInfo(node, depth))
390	      const children = (byManager.get(node.id) || [])
391	        .filter(sameDept)
392	        .slice()
393	        .sort(sortMembers)
394	      for (const c of children) visit(c, depth + 1)
395	    }
396	
397	    for (const r of roots) visit(r, 0)
398	
399	    // Catch any orphan in this department whose reportsTo points outside the
400	    // department (or is null) — render them at depth 0 so nobody is dropped.
401	    const orphans = allNodes
402	      .filter(sameDept)
403	      .filter(n => n.id !== headId && !seen.has(n.id))
404	      .slice()
405	      .sort(sortMembers)
406	    for (const o of orphans) visit(o, 0)
407	
408	    return out
409	  }
410	
411	  // Org Structure v2 — group flat members into sub-department buckets using
412	  // the server-provided subDepartments definition. Falls back to flat list
413	  // when sub-dept data missing (back-compat for unmigrated agents).
414	  const buildSubDeptGroups = (
415	    deptDef: OrgChartData['departments'][number],
416	    flatMembers: MemberInfo[],
417	    headId: string | null,
418	  ): SubDeptGroup[] => {
419	    if (!deptDef.subDepartments || deptDef.subDepartments.length === 0) return []
420	    const groups: SubDeptGroup[] = deptDef.subDepartments
421	      // Skip explicitly-hidden sub-depts (displayMode='hidden')
422	      .filter(sd => sd.displayMode !== 'hidden')
423	      .map(sd => ({
424	        id: sd.id,
425	        label: sd.label,
426	        description: sd.description,
427	        pod: sd.pod || null,
428	        // Pass through all visual fields for the card renderer
429	        cardLabel: sd.cardLabel || null,
430	        cardEmoji: sd.cardEmoji || null,
431	        color: sd.color || null,
432	        icon: sd.icon || null,
433	        displayMode: sd.displayMode || 'expanded',
434	        status: sd.status || 'active',
435	        lead: sd.lead || null,
436	        memberCount: sd.memberCount ?? null,
437	        order: sd.order ?? 999,
438	        members: flatMembers.filter(m => {
439	          // Skip dept head (rendered as Row 1 leader card)
440	          if (m.id === headId) return false
441	          return m.subDepartment === sd.id
442	        }),
443	      }))
444	      // Keep cards with members OR cards explicitly marked active/planned (so
445	      // empty "planned" placeholders still render — useful for cohort previews).
446	      .filter(g => g.members.length > 0 || g.status === 'planned' || g.status === 'active')
447	      .sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 999) - (b.order ?? 999))
448	    return groups
449	  }
450	
451	  const departments = departmentList
452	    .map(d => {
453	      const head = d.head ? byId.get(d.head) || null : null
454	      const flatMembers = buildColumnMembers(d.id, d.head || null)
455	      const subDeptGroups = buildSubDeptGroups(d, flatMembers, d.head || null)
456	      // Visible (non-head) members — head is rendered as the Row 1 leader card.
457	      const visibleCount = head ? flatMembers.filter(m => m.id !== head.id).length : flatMembers.length
458	      return {
459	        id: d.id,
460	        label: d.label,
461	        color: d.color,
462	        head,
463	        visibleCount,
464	        members: flatMembers,
465	        subDeptGroups,
466	      }
467	    })
468	    // Hide executive-style depts whose only "member" is Yash (rendered on Row 0).
469	    // Keep depts with a real head + non-head members, OR depts that have members
470	    // even when headless (like __unassigned__ added below).
471	    .filter(d => {
472	      if (yash && d.head?.id === yash.id && d.visibleCount === 0) return false
473	      return d.head || d.visibleCount > 0
474	    })
475	
476	  // Unassigned column: agents whose `department` is missing or 'unassigned',
477	  // and who aren't Yash or a dept head. These are typically newly-seeded
478	  // probation/pending agents waiting on HR triage.
479	  const renderedIds = new Set<string>()
480	  if (yash) renderedIds.add(yash.id)
481	  for (const d of departments) {
482	    if (d.head) renderedIds.add(d.head.id)
483	    for (const m of d.members) renderedIds.add(m.id)
484	  }
485	  const unassigned = allNodes
486	    .filter(n => !renderedIds.has(n.id))
487	    .slice()
488	    .sort(sortMembers)
489	  if (unassigned.length > 0) {
490	    departments.push({
491	      id: UNASSIGNED_DEPT_ID,
492	      label: 'Unassigned',
493	      color: NEUTRAL_DEPT_COLOR,
494	      head: null,
495	      members: unassigned.map(n => toMemberInfo(n, 0)),
496	      subDeptGroups: [],
497	      visibleCount: unassigned.length,
498	    })
499	  }

501	  // ── Render plan — Row 2 columns ─────────────────────────────────────────────
502	  // Layout strategy:
503	  //   - Most depts: 1 col = 1 dept (with internal sub-dept group headers).
504	  //   - Dense depts (≥SPLIT_THRESHOLD_MEMBERS, ≥SPLIT_THRESHOLD_SUBDEPTS): each
505	  //     sub-dept becomes its own column header — but packed into a GRID
506	  //     (DENSE_GRID_COLS wide × N tall) so we don't blow up canvas width.
507	  //   - Engineering's 6 sub-pods → 3-wide × 2-tall grid → 3 col-widths instead
508	  //     of 6, plus rows go down vertically.
509	  //   - VP card centered over the dept's full grid span.
510	  const SPLIT_THRESHOLD_MEMBERS = 8
511	  const SPLIT_THRESHOLD_SUBDEPTS = 2
512	  const DENSE_GRID_COLS = 3
513	  const DENSE_GRID_ROW_GAP = 28 // vertical gap between sub-col rows
514	
515	  type DeptEntry = typeof departments[number]
516	  type SubdeptEntry = {
517	    label: string
518	    members: MemberInfo[]
519	    subDeptId: string
520	    cardLabel?: string | null
521	    cardEmoji?: string | null
522	    color?: string | null
523	    icon?: string | null
524	    status?: 'active' | 'planned' | 'archived'
525	    description?: string
526	    isOther?: boolean
527	  }
528	  type ColumnPlan =
529	    | { kind: 'dept'; dept: DeptEntry; deptColor: string; label: string; members: MemberInfo[]; subDeptGroups?: SubDeptGroup[] }
530	    | { kind: 'subdept'; dept: DeptEntry; deptColor: string; label: string; members: MemberInfo[]; subDeptId: string; gridRow: number; gridCol: number;
531	        cardLabel?: string | null; cardEmoji?: string | null; color?: string | null; icon?: string | null; status?: 'active' | 'planned' | 'archived'; description?: string; isOther?: boolean }
532	
533	  const plan: ColumnPlan[] = []
534	  for (const d of departments) {
535	    const groups = d.subDeptGroups || []
536	    const visibleHead = d.head?.id
537	    const nonHead = (xs: MemberInfo[]) => visibleHead ? xs.filter(m => m.id !== visibleHead) : xs
538	    const totalVisible = nonHead(d.members).length
539	    const shouldSplit = groups.length >= SPLIT_THRESHOLD_SUBDEPTS && totalVisible >= SPLIT_THRESHOLD_MEMBERS
540	
541	    if (shouldSplit) {
